name: flagship-sumi
description: Flagship theme sumi (cmux#47278), with its type set as settings for builds before the theme-file font keys.

files.themes/sumi.json:
// Sumi: ink on washi. Warm paper glass over Hokusai's Mount Fuji, sumi-black text, one seal-red
// accent, a serif reading face and almost no motion. Copy it to ~/.config/cmux/themes/sumi.json
// (yours wins over this one), edit and save: the running app repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "Sumi",
  "description": "Ink on washi paper over Hokusai's Fuji; one seal-red accent, serif reading, stillness.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors: ink tones, with the seal's red as the only loud color.
  "appearance.theme": "Kanagawa Lotus",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#f4eee1",
    "foreground": "#1f1c18",
    "cursor": "#b8322a",
    "selection": "#e3d9c3",
    "accent": "#b8322a",
    "0": "#1f1c18",
    "1": "#b8322a",
    "2": "#5b6e3a",
    "3": "#9a6a1f",
    "4": "#3a5577",
    "5": "#7b4a6e",
    "6": "#3f6f6a",
    "7": "#d8cfbb",
    "8": "#6b6458",
    "9": "#d2463b",
    "10": "#76894f",
    "11": "#b78630",
    "12": "#52719a",
    "13": "#98618a",
    "14": "#568c86",
    "15": "#fbf8f0"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The print behind paper: mostly paper.
  "appearance.background": "hokusai-umezawa",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "frosted",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.2,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": false,

  // One sheet of paper: no borders, a slightly darker sidebar, quiet sections in lines.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#ebe3d1",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.9,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#f4eee1",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f4eee1",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#f4eee1",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.6,
  "appearance.borders": "none",

  // Type: Folio's Hanken Grotesk in the chrome, serif for reading, the chat and Markdown both.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "hanken",
  "agentPane.display.font.preset": "serif",
  "markdown.font.preset": "serif",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  // Stillness: calm motion, a static red seal for work.
  "ui.calm": "calm",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "static",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#b8322a",

  "appearance.density": "spacious"
}
